verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an LLM gateway, so the axis applies. Every piece of evidence describes Requesty as a hosted service: clients point at router.requesty.ai, and even the EU routing option runs on Requesty's own AWS Frankfurt infrastructure. Nothing documents a self-hostable deployment, distribution, or source release.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
